name: How am I supposed to fit in at college when there aren't any other animal people but I'm a POSSUM BOY!: The Ballad of Joey Virginia
source: POSSUM BOY! is a romantic comedy visual novel about finding friendship, finding yourself, and maybe even finding love... when you're the only animal person around!
translation: 负鼠男孩！是一部浪漫喜剧视觉小说，讲述寻找友谊、寻找自我，甚至可能寻找爱情……当你是周围唯一的动物人时！
